newsitem.title: USA: Group has 7.5 pct of Swisher International.
newsitem.headline: Group has 7.5 pct of Swisher International.

text.p: A group that includes New York investment limited partnership Zweig-DiMenna Special Opportunities LP said it has acquired 448,100 class A common shares of Swisher International Group Inc, or 7.5 percent of the total outstanding.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group, which includes Zweig Fund Inc and Zweig Total Return Fund Inc Chairman Martin Zweig said it acquired the stake for investment purposes.
The group said it bought its stake between Dec. 23, 1996 and Jan. 31, 1997 at prices ranging from $14.9375 to $17.8986 a share.
